Class Terminal

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.io.Symbol
edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.io.Terminal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pattern
Direct Known Subclasses:
Single
public abstract class Terminal extends Symbol
A terminal symbol is a primitive element in a grammar used by a parser which cannot be broken down into smaller parts.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
